sources.title: kikirara_vivi_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive DEV_IS]]'s [[Kikirara Vivi]].

She wears a [[black bra]] worn over a [[cropped shirt|cropped]] [[white shirt]] with [[purple arm warmers]], [[black thighhighs]], [[black shorts]] and [[black shoes]].

She has [[very long hair|very long]] [[pink hair]] with [[purple streaks]] tied into [[twintails]] held together with a [[black bow|black]] [[hair bow]].

h4. Appearance
